timers.title: Timers
timers.description: Each row is one timer: on or off, its label, how long it runs (5 seconds to 180 minutes), the reward title, and the Twitch and Kick reward IDs. An ID is matched first, so renaming the reward never breaks the timer; the title is used only when no ID is set for that platform.

repeatMode.title: When a running timer is redeemed again

runMode.title: When different timers are redeemed
runMode.description: One at a time: a new timer waits until the current one ends, then starts with its full time. Together: timers run side by side.

command.title: Moderator command
command.description: Moderators and you type !timer <label> start, !timer <label> stop or !timer clear. Leave empty for no command.

announceStart.title: Post in chat when a timer starts

queuedMessage.title: Message when a timer has to wait
queuedMessage.description: Placeholders: {name}, {label}, {time} and {ahead} (how many timers are ahead of it). Sent to the chat it was redeemed in.
queuedMessage.default: ⏳ {name} queued {label}. It starts when the current timer ends ({ahead} ahead).

announceEnd.title: Post in chat when a timer ends

maxOnScreen.title: Most timers on screen at once
